tools.name: scan_accessibility
tools.description: Automated technical accessibility pre-check (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA via axe-core) for one public https:// URL, rendered in a real headless browser, mapped to German BFSG requirements. Catches roughly 57% of WCAG violations — NOT a substitute for a manual audit and never a conformity proof. Results are cach

tools.name: draft_statement
tools.description: Draft a German accessibility statement (Erklärung zur Barrierefreiheit) for a website, optionally enriched with a previous scan_accessibility result. Missing legally-required facts come back as [[PLACEHOLDERS]] you must fill in; the draft needs legal review before publication. Pure text generation,
